candidates.name: Arktikum Science Centre
candidates.price: €18 for adults, €11 for students, the fee covers re-entry on the same day; Museum Card valid
candidates.hours: 10:00–17:00 daily in summer, Tue–Sun in winter
candidates.content: One of the best museums and science centres in Finland, focusing on life in the Arctic regions through the ages as well as the Sami culture, history of Finnish Lapland and Rovaniemi city. The museum shop has books, postcards, deli

candidates.name: Forestry Museum of Lapland
candidates.price: €6/4, reduced price for students and children, Museum Card valid
candidates.content: A fancy museum dedicated to forestry in Lapland from 1870 to the 1970s. The museum consist of old buildings brought here from all around the province, and the collections are inside the buildings. The museum area is also worth vis

candidates.name: Local Heritage Museum
candidates.price: €6/4, reduced price for students and children, Museum Card valid
candidates.content: A local history museum. The main building and two outbuildings built in 1840, 14 relocated buildings from the Rovaniemi area. The collections consist of household items, hunting and fishing equipment, and agricultural tools. From

candidates.name: Korundi House of Culture
candidates.content: Art, music and other culture events. The art museum collection consists mostly of modern Finnish art. Home of the Chamber Orchestra of Lapland.

candidates.name: Lutheran church
candidates.content: Built 1950, near the administrative centre. Famous for its considerable large fresco "Spring of the Life" by professor Lennart Segerstråle. The fresco and other wall paintings use elements of Lapland in Biblical context (for examp

candidates.name: Somonen Nature Church
candidates.content: Unlike many conventional churches, this outdoor place of worship is made of glacial erratic boulders, transforming into a natural church hall with the help of a wooden cross and seat planks. A small bell tower has also been built

candidates.name: German Soldier Cemetery
candidates.content: This is the final resting place for 2,683 German soldiers who died during the World War II in Lapland. Constructed of large stone blocks and located virtually in the middle of nowhere, it seems to be of interest to some, as there

candidates.name: Jätkänkynttilä bridge
candidates.content: Accomplished in 1989, the bridge has become one of the most important symbols of Rovaniemi. It runs over the Kemijoki close the northern end of the city centre. The bridge has a high pylon with bright yellow light on top.

candidates.name: Orthodox church
candidates.content: A small Orthodox church is on the other side of the Kemijoki river. Built 1957 and dedicated to Saint Apostle Andrew.

candidates.name: Auttiköngäs waterfall
candidates.content: A 16-m-high waterfall and old-growth forest. Bus stop at the road, parking area 1 km farther. A 50-m steep trail for wheelchairs (assistance needed) to a hut with view to the rapids, a 3.5-km nature trail through varying terrain,

candidates.name: Santa Claus Village
candidates.content: Located right on the old computed place of the Arctic Circle (now computed to be 2 km north), this is a tourist trap if there ever was one – but few tourists can miss the chance to meet Santa Claus. Apart from meeting him, there a

candidates.name: Santapark
candidates.content: Underground amusement park within walking distance from Santa Claus Village. Open only during the winter season.

candidates.name: Kirkkolampi Arboretum
candidates.content: Popular park around the Kirkkolampi pond. Over 250 species of subarctic trees and perennials.

candidates.name: Arctic Arboretum
candidates.content: The arboretum is about 7 hectares in size and on the southern bank of the Ounas river behind the Arktikum Science Centre. It showcases plant species which survive in the local conditions, with an emphasis on varieties of trees. Be

candidates.name: Pilke Science Centre
candidates.price: €7/5, reduced price for students and children 7–15, Museum Card valid
candidates.content: Those attracted by northern forests will want to visit Pilke, where exhibitions describe sustainable use of northern forests and diverse yields, forest products and commodities. Same day re-entry free of charge, lockers available.

candidates.name: Saarenpudas bridge
candidates.content: This tiny (just 16 m long) arched bridge, completed in 1925, is the only bridge on the road to the Arctic Ocean that was not destroyed by German soldiers during the Lapland War 1944–1945.

candidates.name: Administrative and Cultural Centre
candidates.content: The rebuilding of Rovaniemi after World War II was largely planned by the famous Finnish architect Alvar Aalto – particularly its reindeer antler layout. He also designed the Administrative and Cultural Centre which includes the L

candidates.name: Korkalonrinne residential area
candidates.content: Interesting, if you are into architecture by Alvar Aalto. The Korkalonrinne residential area consist of bright white row houses and apartment buildings in a park-like surroundings. Built 1956–1958 this neighbourhood follows his vi

candidates.name: Haunted Walk and Gallery of Darkness
candidates.hours: In summer: Wed–Fri 12:00–18:00, Sat 12:00–16:00; other times by request
candidates.content: A horror-themed art gallery by Hanna Pilve.

candidates.name: Sukulanrakka Giant's Kettles
candidates.price: The site is free-of-charge to visit; shelter facilities €30/10 people, bigger groups or overnighting in the shelter €50
candidates.content: Fourteen giant's kettles, including three very deep ones, can be found on the Sukulanrakka hill slopes near the island of Rautiosaari. Nature trail with stairs, partly rough. No public transportation.

candidates.name: Häkinvaara hut
candidates.content: In the village of Saarenkylä, on the top of Häkinvaara a stone-built kota, in front of which opens an amazing view over the rivers Ounasjoki and Kemijoki.

candidates.name: Lapland Escape
candidates.price: From €100–200 for daytrips of 2½–9 hr including transfers
candidates.content: Small-group tour operator offering Northern Lights excursions, snowmobile safaris, husky tours, reindeer experiences, hiking and national park tours. Tours are available in English, Italian, Chinese, Polish and Spanish (depending

candidates.name: Ounasvaara nature trail
candidates.content: A 4.8-km-long circular nature trail with info plates both in Finnish and English. The starting point is by a parking lot some 600 m uphill from Santasport. Conifer forest, small bogs, awesome views down to the river valley, and tw

candidates.name: Ounasvaara winter walking trail
candidates.content: First of all: it is absolutely forbidden to walk on a skiing track. If you don't have skis but still wish to see how the forest looks like at winter, don't worry. There is a 6-km-long winter walking trail at Ounasvaara hill. The t

candidates.name: Koivusaari nature trail
candidates.content: Another nature trail within walking distance from the city centre, on Koivusaari island. The islands at the confluence of rivers Ounasjoki and Kemijoki are protected as a remarkable nesting site for birds. There is a 2.5-km-long n

candidates.name: Santa Claus Forest nature trail
candidates.content: A nature trail next to the Santa Claus Village. From the Santa's Village you need to walk through the underpass next to the bus stop and there you are. The trail starts with duckboards over a beautiful aapa-type mire (aapa mires a

candidates.name: Harjulampi bird watching tower
candidates.content: Wooden bird watching tower by the eutrophic lake Harjulampi, built in 1995. Over 80 bird species have been observed here, of which 32 nest here regularly. Easy to access as the tower is less than 100 m off the street and within wa

candidates.name: Louevaara cabin
candidates.content: The deserted cabin is the former fire guard's hut. The wilderness cabin is log-built, reasonably spacious and gets warm enough to sleep in during the winter (using the stove). In the vicinity of the hut, about half a kilometre awa

candidates.name: KesäRafla summer restaurant and sauna
candidates.price: Sauna free in summer; towel €5; in winter with ice swimming €24/1½ hr
candidates.content: Open June-August. Very popular unisex sauna for up to 35 people. Beach volley court and SUP board rental. The terrace restaurant offers drinks and charcoal grilled food. In winter 2024 there is also the WNTR Sauna.

candidates.name: Unique Lapland
candidates.content: Produces program services, rents and sells snowmobiles, roadsters, and ATVs, organises events, concerts, training and coaching and sells high quality outdoor clothing.

candidates.name: Rovaniemi Theatre
candidates.content: Plays in Finnish. Students get about 50% discount from the ticket price.

candidates.name: Keskuskenttä Stadium
candidates.content: Multi-purpose stadium for football and athletics with official FIFA certification. Home stadium for local football clubs RoPS and FC Santa Claus. Capacity up to 5000 seats with 2800 seats in the covered main stand. Three full-leng

candidates.name: Mäntyvaara Race Track
candidates.content: A harness racing track.

candidates.name: Santasport
candidates.content: Leisure and well-being activities from bowling to spa and from massaging to outdoor fun. Disc golf course. Santasport is a vocational school for sports and an internationally acknowledged training centre for professional athletes.

candidates.name: Paavalniemi bird watching tower
candidates.content: Popular bird watching tower at a place where river Kemijoki expands into a lush bay, about 10 km off-town. Numerous northern waders and waterfowl. The tower is on the point of peninsula, a 300-m walk from the end of the road, and

candidates.name: Ounaspaviljonki beach
candidates.content: Popular sand beach by river Ounasjoki. Playground for children and a beach volley court. Café service in the summer.

candidates.name: Santasport Spa
candidates.content: The spa is suitable for competitive swimmers, water sports enthusiasts and tourists alike. The pool area has a large pool, a children’s pool, hot and cold pools, a hot tub, a hot tub and a massage pool.

candidates.name: Taava Reindeer Farm
candidates.content: See reindeer up close either at the Arctic Circle or 30 minutes away by car at the farm (pickup at the Joulumaa address).

candidates.name: Roy Club
candidates.content: Known as Roippari by the locals. Small nightclub established in 1985 and open every single day of the year. Awarded as the Best Bar in Finland 2016. Karaoke pub in the ground floor, nightclub in the cellar. Age limit 18.

candidates.name: Kansan Pubi
candidates.price: Free admission, €3.5 for a 0.4-L domestic beer.
candidates.content: Cheapest and therefore also fairly popular among young locals. Might be surprisingly crowded during the weekend evenings before people head to the nightclubs. Age limit 18.

candidates.name: Café Kauppayhtiö
candidates.content: Sandwich shop, ice cream, milkshakes, hamburger restaurant and bar. Lunch. Its slogan is "the café where everything is for sale". The Pure Pizza has authentic Neapolitan style pizzas.

candidates.name: Pub Pisto
candidates.content: A stylish public house established already in 1960. According to famous Rovaniemi-born novellist Jari Tervo "You haven't been in Rovaniemi unless you have been in Pisto". This pub appears in many of Tervo's novels.

candidates.name: Pub Oluthuone
candidates.content: Cosy and fairly typical Finnish pub at the pedestrian street but for some odd reason doesn't seem to attract too much foreigners. Customers are mostly 30-year-old and up locals. Cheaper than many other bars in the centre. Pool tab

candidates.name: Lapland Brewery
candidates.content: The northernmost brewery of Finland, established in 2016.

candidates.name: Oliver's Corner
candidates.content: Irish style pub with a cosy nightclub and customers typically over 25 years. The place is often crowded and the line outdoors might get long.

candidates.name: Bar 21
candidates.content: Café, gelateria, tapas and cocktail bar. Brunch every Sunday.

candidates.name: Rock Bar Grande
candidates.content: Rockish bar established in 1991 (but moved thrice since) in the Sampokeskus shopping centre. Entrance from Pekankatu. Occasionally live artists.

candidates.name: Paha Kurki Rockhouse
candidates.content: Notable rock-ish beerhouse, close to the safari company offices near the river.

candidates.name: Bar Iloinen Ilves
candidates.hours: Tue–Sun 16:00 until the closing time; Mon closed
candidates.content: Right next to the Paha Kurki. A very small pub without background music. Fancy Rovaniemi themed interior.

candidates.name: Bar Hemingway's
candidates.content: A Finnish franchise pub. Age limit 20.

candidates.name: Uitto Pub
candidates.content: A popular old-time forestry themed pub. Pizzas, salads and hot dogs for food.

candidates.name: Bar Zoomit
candidates.content: Café and trendy cocktail bar in the lobby of Hotel Santa Claus.

candidates.name: Pandakeidas
candidates.content: Roadside restaurant. Chinese and European kitchen, sautéed reindeer and hamburgers (also take-away). Wi-Fi. Fuel. Small shop. Accommodation in four rooms (en suite shower and toilet), one of which for families. Camper parking.

candidates.name: McDonald's Rovaniemi Lampela
candidates.content: For over two decades the world's northernmost McD was at Rovaniemi, and perhaps again, as the ones in Arkhangelsk and Murmansk (Russia) are no more McD. In 2024 Rovaniemi McD moved some 1 km southwards and is now located next to M

candidates.name: Korundi Kitchen and Café
candidates.content: Lunch restaurant and art café in the lobby of the art museum.

candidates.name: Alvari food and drink
candidates.content: The restaurant at the railway station is not bad or too expensive either.

candidates.name: Hook Rovaniemi
candidates.content: Wings and other finger food.

candidates.name: Lapin Krassi
candidates.content: Weekday lunch special.

candidates.name: Kotipizza Koskikatu
candidates.content: Finnish pizza franchising restaurant.

candidates.name: Turkinpippuri
candidates.content: Serves good kebab & pizza. Try the kebab roll!

candidates.name: Santa's Döner Kebab
candidates.content: Excellent self-made döner.

candidates.name: Pizzeria Trocadero
candidates.content: For some reason, vastly oversize pizzas seem to be some thing in Northern Finland. Here you'll find the biggest ones in Rovaniemi.

candidates.name: Venetsia Pizza and Kebab
candidates.content: Pizzas from a wood-burning oven. Kebabs, chicken döner, etc.

candidates.name: Subway Sampokeskus
candidates.content: Subs.

candidates.name: Rinteenkulma
candidates.content: Grocery store (K-supermarket), local design shops, souvenir shop, sports equipment. The K-supermarket Rinteenkulma has a wide selection of local delicacies including reindeer meat products.

candidates.name: K-Citymarket Rovaniemi
candidates.content: K-group hypermarket. There are also recycling stations, an Alko store, a flower shop Elrika, a Subway café, and a Hesburger hamburger restaurant in the same building.

candidates.name: Prisma Rovaniemi
candidates.content: S-group hypermarket near the city's industry area. Notable selection of trekking equipment. Alko store, Pharmacy, and a Hesburger hamburger restaurant in the same building.

candidates.name: K-Market Kairatie
candidates.content: Small grocery store in residential area. Fuel station across the road. Long distance bus stop to direction Kittilä-Muonio-Enontekiö-Tromsø is 200 metres north, behind the roundabout.

candidates.name: Minimani Rovaniemi
candidates.content: Hypermarket of a small independent Finnish chain, with an ATM, public laundrette, and a Subway café in the same building.

december.text: There are some souvenirs and fur products for sale at the , on the pedestrian street, and — of course — at the Santa Claus Village. At the once famous there are mostly berries for sale in the summer and Christmas trees before Christmas.

| content=Small camping area opened already in 1972. Cottages by the riverbank in an idyllic and fairly rural landscape. Minimum cottage rental period 6–7 nights during Christmas, 4–5 nights in New Year, and 2–3 nights otherwise. Campers and tents are welcome June–August without minimum stay. Reception open only 15:00–
Kotatieva Winter Leisure Park: An outdoor park for spending an active day. Mostly known for a 500 meters long ice skating track. Available from December to March.
Luckiefun's Sushibuffet: Opened in December 2019. The northernmost sushi buffet in Finland, possibly in the world.
